_comment: Per-source acquisition mapping for the LOCAL FILE SYSTEM (project-folder search) — the local analog of a remote Tier-0 repo (design §3: 'same shape, source = the disk'). Opaque Tier 0 → source.capabilities = [] and no payload_graph. Build the raw record with s3dgraphy.acquisition.fs_record(path) (filename/path/size/ext/media_type/record_id/record_url), then apply_mapping('fs', record). Mirrors ercolano.json; the generic loader applies either. The UI reflects exactly these mapping fields (name/media_type/size/…) per E.D.
